# side-piece

> The other model, on the side. Pins ai-cli-mcp and installs one Agent Skill that
> routes resumable external-model work from Claude Code, Codex, and opencode.

Install by telling your coding agent: Let's install `@tjw.dev/side-piece` in this project, then tell me how to use it

## Docs

- [Install contract (README)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thejustinwalsh/side-piece/main/README.md): the authoritative setup and usage document, also shipped inside the npm tarball
- [Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thejustinwalsh/side-piece/main/skill/side-piece/SKILL.md): the routing skill itself
- [Repository](https://github.com/thejustinwalsh/side-piece)
- [Pinned server](https://github.com/mkXultra/ai-cli-mcp): ai-cli-mcp
